answer: Split rewards by kinship cluster, not by account. If funding trails, timing and shared wording link a hundred wallets, the pool treats them as one claimant and pays one share. An attacker who spins up more fakes just feeds a tighter spiral of evidence while the payout stays flat. Like a tide that rises the same height however many buckets you set out, emission per real operator does not grow with copies. Writing a hundred distinct essays costs real effort; writing one sonnet a hundred times gets you clustered.
